items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: I remember he had a rehearsal one time, when I first came out of the Army, and he had -- the piano player he had at rehearsal... He had Bud Powell on piano

ctx.x: That's right. He had Bud Powell on piano, you know, so he tried the best he could. But he couldn't bring it off.

Then later on he went to California. He went to California, and that's where he ended it all up. That's where he died, in California. But again, you know, a young man. What was he, 37 years old? I think he was a few months older than I. x recte 43
